newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy magistrates to probe Italcementi share trade.
newsitem.headline: Italy magistrates to probe Italcementi share trade.

text.p: Italy's stock market watchdog Consob has asked Milan magistrates to investigate possible insider trading in the saving shares of Italian building products group Italcementi in 1994.
Consob said in a statement that the investigation will focus on the abuse of privileged information in relation to operations regarding Italcementi savings shares before April 22, 1994.
On this date, the group announced a capital increase of 32.7 million ordinary shares and 23.3 million savings shares with warrants that followed in July.
The move follows an initial investigation into possible insider trading by Consob itself.
